description: Cancel one of the traveler's Roomza bookings, inside its free-cancellation window only, with a full refund. Call it first without confirm: it says what would happen and changes nothing. Tell the traveler, and only after they agree call it again with confirm set to true. Outside the window it refuses and points the traveler to Roomza support. Requires connecting your Roomza account.

confirm.description: true only after the traveler agrees

name: cancel_booking

done.description: True once the booking is canceled; false for a preview or a refusal

title: Cancel a booking
